# Prices Decide the Method

<!-- STEP id="flip" -->
Now 4 tailors cost 4 × ₹400 = ₹1,600 a day. The sewing line still costs ₹1,200 a day. The machine is cheaper by ₹400 a day, so Masterji moves to capital-intensive production. Nothing about the tailors changed except their wage.

<!-- STEP id="wage" -->
Move the wage and watch the two bills. At ₹300 a day, 4 tailors cost ₹1,200, the same as the sewing line. Below ₹300 the tailors are cheaper. Above ₹300 the machine is cheaper.

**When the price of workers or machines changes, the best way to produce can change too.**
